description: The fixture's last two rows, 48 and 49, so the browse ends on the highest key the cluster holds. The last-record boundary: the second row is displayed in full and only THEN does the next READ report '10'. On that end-of-file READ the record area is left untouched, exactly as a COBOL READ ... INTO leaves it at AT END, and the :77 guard is what stops the stale record being displayed a third time - which is precisely the defect this case would catch, as a translation that displayed it would emit seven lines instead of six.
